Costa Riga kapulungan a kanatal (nu kamu nu Si-Ban-Ya: República de Costa Rica), ngangan tu Costa riga , u imi malubicay a dadipasan ,nu inutebanan Amiliak a kanatal, nuwamisan belaw u Nicaragua nutimulan u Panama matatules ku lala', kahenulan a tuse u Sen-he-si , Costa riga u ayzaay i kitakit u saayaway mipaelesan a hitay nu kanatal, imahini nu Costa riga nu inutebanan Amiliak a kakitizaan cin-ci u sakapahay nipalahadan a kanatal, kapah makakat kuni kauzip na mahini sibalucu' mipuput tu ihekalay nu mauzipay mulangway i kanatal, yadah ku nu lalayan tu pidiputan, masilut tu i bu-pu-se masilut tu 2020 a mihcaan miales tu namalahitay mananeng tu singangan tu i kanatal. (u kamu nu Hulam sa: Costa riga :República de Costa Rica), .) laylay iayaw a zitay nu Ke-lung-pu , izaw tu muengen ku In-di-an a tdemaw i tini i Costa riga u Cung-mey-cow-uan-min makakatay ku nika uzip atu An-ti-se-wen-min i kalikeluhan. (u kamu nu Hulam sa: .) kasumamadan tu 16 a mihcaan, i tiniay a Ya-me a tademaw a tademaw atu A-ce-tay-ce a tademaw, mademec nu Spain a tademaw, satu Costa riga mala u Spain a lala' baluhay a Spain satimulan a kenis,i sebu i tiza i Ka-ta-ke (Cartago). (u kamu nu Hulam sa: 16世紀, (Cartago).) Costa riga makalaliw tu nipitebung ilawlaw nu Cung-may-cow paykanatal masumad tu kawaw nu hitay, caay kalecat tu nu belaw nu kanatal, Costa riga u tanektekay masungaay atu binawlan kumikuwanay tu mahiniay, kasumamdan tu 19 a mihcaan tu zikuzan, kinatusa pacena tu uni u kalalepu a kawaw masawacu tu kunipalahat nu binawlan, 1948 a mihcaan kangangayaw nu kanatal Costa riga a Cung-tung ci He-say-bey-ke-lay-si-bey-lay-rl musakamu paliwasak tu hitay, atu i 1949 a mihcaan unian pahulic han, namahini hausa Costa riga mikaput tu nayay a hitay mikaput tunu binawlanay a nizatengan.Costa riga anumahinihini mahiza tu palekal tu kanatalay , nika malecat tu katalakaw kuni kauzip, izaw amin ku tantuwa' nu lala', saaca papiidangay a kawaw macakat kuni palahat. .) helal nu lala' Costa riga i tini inutebanan Amilika tanayu'ay likecu'ay a kakitizaan, amis balattu cacay bataan a tu(北緯10度), tipan balattu walu bataan izaw ku sepat a tu(西經84度), nutimulan micapi tu Ciy-le-pi' a bayu , satipan micapi nuwamisan a waliyu , izaw ku 1,290 malebut miy ku dadipasan (nuwalian a tukus Ciy-le-pi-hay 212 malebut nu miy, satipan a tukus u waliyu 1016 malaebut a depah.Costa riga nuwamisan atu Nicaragua matatules ku lala', u lilis nu kanatal a katanayu' 309 malebut miy, nuwalian nutimulan pasayza i nutimulan atu nu Panama a lala' (u lilis nu kanatal a katanayu' 639 malebut miy). pulung izaw ku 51,100 km2, namakasalala'ay 50,660 km2, i lilis nu nanum 440 km2, palaleca tu nu Amilika a Si-wyi-ci-niy-ya-cuw kaadidi', amahiza tu nu Ireland . Costa riga u liwliw nu lala', dadipasan u masaenalay, tepanay nukanatal masalikaku ku buyu' masulaed, uynian a kanatal sakamusa uyni simungay situngusay tu sikikalisiwan a kenis 200 km katanayu' nu bayu, nubayuwan 12 km katanayu' nu bayu,u bali u akutiay atu tatungusay a akuti' izaw henay ku zuma' u baluhay a akuti'ay. Costa riga u saicelangay nu hulic a nilekecaan tu mahiniay u sunida kapulungan a kanatal , mikawaway tuni cenbu u sidimada u cung-tung ku situngusay, u icelang nu cung-tung kapulung nu kanatal, uynian a kanatal tusa ku midabay atu pasu cacay tademaw midapay tu cung-tung 15 ku tademaw masakaputay nu lalabu nu mikawaway, Cung-tung atu 57 a tademaw nu lipuing a giing u nisikiwan, i sepat a mihcaan mala giing. Costa riga u inutebanan Amilika a kakitizaan a sakikalisiw u macakatay a kanatal, kapah kuni kauzip atu kayadah ku sakikalisiwan, uyni u kikasumat nu sakikalisiwan hawsa, Costa riga i ayaw namiida tu nikalukan uyni dada' ku palahatan tu sakikalisiwan uyni u aidangan u dikiay atu sapangaay tu imelangay pulung han patahakal atu pasubana' tu tineng nikawaw tu angangan tu yadahay tu canacananay a sakikalisiwan. Costa riga nu papiidangay a kawaw paymihcaan kunilaculan a kalisiw 19.2 a i'ek nu Amei-lika a kalisiw, nu Cung-may a kakitizaan mizizaway a kanatal miidangay a lapng u sakatuuday nu kanatal, 2013 a mihcaan 242 a mang ku nu tuway kanatal a labang, kayadah ku lalayan nu mauzipay mulangaway, palalecat tu kapahay u angangan nupatizang atu kapahay a nipikuwan nu kanatal , uynian a kanatal papiidangay a kawaw u lalayan izaw tu ku nidademec , u kapahay a idangan izaw ku Yi-la-su silamalay a buyu, A-lel-na'silamalay a buyu Po-lay-se silamalay a buyu', Ao-si-siw-na-el a kanayal, nu kanatalay nu buyu'ay mipaydangay kakitizaan miading tu aadupan, Meng-te-wo-de-yum-wu' a buyu'an pitiputan tu kakitizaan, Spain nu micumuday a tademaw nisubelidan a lalangawan . Costa riga a tademawan malalamelay izang a wawa atu tatenga'ay nu Europe a tademaw pakala' tu siwa a bataan izaw ku sepat a pasantu 94%, angangan mabulaway nu Spain a tademaw, uzuma yadah henay kunu Germany a tademaw, Poland a tademaw, Italy a tademaw atu Jewish a tademaw , i Costa riga uyza dada' cayay kakatuud ku Indians (In-ti-an a tademaw 印第安人) makay satipan midebungay ku mauzip, ayza u muenengay nu binacadan a tademaw 29,000 a tademaw dada'caay kaedeng tu pilung nu tademaw tu cacay a pasentu. inahini Italy a tademaw a tademaw macunus tu katuud nu tademaw, angangan u sakangelih uyni an u mabulaawy a kaizaw kakanan nu tademaw, a pakala tu a izaw ku sakalukan numalukay a tademaw. Costa riga atu Mey-kuo i kasumamadan malalayattuay tu Amilika atu sakakaput a kanatal, Costa riga i 2007 a mihcaan atu Cung-haw-min-kuo makaketun malacabay, pananiyul atu China malacabay, satu paales hantu ku Cung-ha-min-kuo mingkiw asa caay a pangangan micumud tu kanatal , namahini hawsa masusul , hamin nu mingkiw nu Cung-haw-min-kuo a minkiw a caay pangangan amicumut tu Costa riga a kanatal atu ci pazena' mihibamh sayadahay a demiad 90.
